excluded_source: website/routes/console.php contains commands/schedules, not HTTP routes; no routes/api.php in tracked active app tree.
unresolved: Effective API throttles are configuration expressions: 'throttle:'.($rate['read'] ?? '120,1'), check fallback 60,1, write fallback 20,1; retained as EXPR values.

The SectionController::room($view) helper is resolved from literal caller arguments (account.hosting/account.servers/account.other); Admin\MarketingController::show maps both conditional view branches.
Controller authorization, form/CSRF behavior, host redirects and data-dependent view branches require isolated runtime verification.
Dynamic view expressions remain in per-row view_expressions; helper scan does not prove all runtime branches.
No Route::domain groups found. Host policy is middleware-defined; domain field is policy context, not an explicit route domain constraint.
Route::redirect declarations cover all Laravel redirect methods; GET routes include implied HEAD. Runtime framework/version handling and automatic OPTIONS are not boot-verified.
Global middleware is recorded once in architecture below, not duplicated into each route row.
